title: Check the local controller
summary: Prepare the existing local check-mode recipe using an explicit private target.

target.description: A target name from your private environment

expected_results: A static check plan with an approval digest
No tools run during discovery, validation or planning

known_failures.summary: The supplied name is not a private target reference
next_checks: Inspect targets in your private environment JSON
recovery: Correct the reference and prepare a new plan

known_failures.summary: An input or operation instruction changed after review
next_checks: Compare the current recipe, operation metadata, inventory and variables
recovery: Inspect the changes and create a new plan; do not reuse the old digest

limitations: This example does not qualify a remote host
Declared tool versions and requirements are not checked during discovery
